critical_prerequisite_finding: relation_mixer is structurally gradient-dead in this pipeline (num_source_slots()==1, softmax over a size-1 axis is the constant function beta=1 with zero Jacobian) -- confirmed empirically (weight hashes identical pre/post training) and analytically (isolated unit test). Only `gate` genuinely trains in ANY arm. See AUDIT.md.

scenario_A_M2_confirmed.verdict: NOT MET (O3 beats O1 significantly, but does not clearly beat O0)

scenario_B_M2_competitive.criteria: |relative gap O3 vs O1| < 0.5% AND both beat O0
scenario_B_M2_competitive.verdict: PARTIALLY MET (gap is tiny, 0.087%, favoring M2) but neither arm clearly beats O0

interaction_O4_minus_O3_minus_O2_minus_O.interpretation: positive => Host penalty is LARGER for M2 than for J1

aggregation_verdict.note: Uniform significantly beats Host for J1 (O1<O2). For M2, Uniform vs Host is NOT significant (O3 vs O4 CI includes zero). The interaction term is significant and NEGATIVE: the Host penalty (Host-Uniform) is actually SMALLER for M2 (+0.00018) than for J1 (+0.00117) once a trainable gate is allowed to partially compensate -- opposite direction from TRACK-N's standalone-retrieval-quality damage finding (there M2 suffered MORE %-damage). The gate can partially absorb the standalone Host degradation, more so for M2 than J1.

case_4_rationale: All four arms land within [-0.00001, +0.0017] of O0 (base_mse=0.488790) -- 3/4 differences are statistically significant (large n) but ALL are practically negligible (<0.4% relative), and none represent a genuine, meaningful improvement over the trivial no-retrieval baseline (O1/O2/O4 are actually slightly WORSE than O0; O3 is statistically tied). This is Case 4's own trigger condition: Stage2 consumer architecture itself fails to exploit real retrieval information, for ANY retriever or aggregation tested. Retriever must NOT be changed; consumer architecture needs redesign.

secondary_finding_M2_relatively_better.note: Despite neither retriever achieving a meaningful absolute win over O0, M2 SIGNIFICANTLY beats J1 pairwise under IDENTICAL treatment in BOTH aggregation modes -- consistent with TRACK-N's finding that M2's retrieval carries real, competitive-to-superior conditional utility that the current consumer (gate alone, mixer dead) fails to fully realize for either retriever, but fails LESS for M2.
